ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Use the graph below, consisting of two line segments and a quarter-circle. The graph shows the velocity of an object during a 6-second interval. During what time interval (in sec) is the speed increasing?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a graph of velocity v changing with time t; the horizontal axis is t (seconds), and the vertical axis is v. When 0<t<3, the graph is a downward line segment, decreasing from v=3 to v=0; when 3<t<5, it is a quarter-circular arc located below the t-axis, decreasing from v=0 to v=-2; when 5<t<6, it is an upward line segment, rising from v=-2 back to v=0. Then reason: What the problem asks is speed increasing, that is, whether the magnitude of velocity |v| is increasing. When speed increases, the distance from the graph to the t-axis is becoming larger. When 0<t<3, v changes from positive to smaller until 0, and |v| is decreasing; when 3<t<5, v changes from 0 to -2, getting farther and farther from the t-axis, and |v| is increasing; when 5<t<6, v returns from -2 to 0, and |v| is decreasing. Therefore, the interval in which speed increases is 3<t<5.

raw_record.question_text:
Use the graph below, consisting of two line segments and a quarter-circle. The graph shows the velocity of an object during a 6-second interval.

During what time interval (in sec) is the speed increasing?

method.method_draft: Read the graph as a velocity-vs-time graph over 0 to 6 seconds. From the image, identify that the velocity is above the t-axis and moving toward 0 on 0<t<3, then below the t-axis and moving farther away from 0 along the quarter-circle on 3<t<5, then below the t-axis but moving back toward 0 on 5<t<6. Use the text statement that the graph gives velocity and the question asks when speed is increasing. Apply the rule speed = |velocity|, so speed increases exactly when the graph’s vertical distance from the t-axis increases. This occurs only on 3<t<5.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是速度 v 随时间 t 变化的图像，横轴是 t（秒），纵轴是 v。图像在 0<t<3 时是一条向下的线段，从 v=3 下降到 v=0；在 3<t<5 时是一段位于 t 轴下方的四分之一圆弧，从 v=0 下降到 v=-2；在 5<t<6 时是一条向上的线段，从 v=-2 上升回 v=0。再推理：题目问的是 speed increasing，也就是速度大小 |v| 是否在增大。速度增大时，图像到 t 轴的距离在变大。0<t<3 时，v 由正变小到 0，|v| 在减小；3<t<5 时，v 由 0 变到 -2，离 t 轴越来越远，|v| 在增大；5<t<6 时，v 由 -2 回到 0，|v| 在减小。所以速度增加的区间是 3<t<5。

method.method_draft: Read the graph piecewise and determine the sign of velocity and the sign of the graph’s slope on each interval. On 0<t<3, the graph is above the t-axis, so v>0, but the line slopes downward, so acceleration is negative; speed is decreasing. On 3<t<5, the quarter-circle is below the t-axis and slopes downward, so v<0 and acceleration is negative; velocity and acceleration have the same sign, so speed is increasing. On 5<t<6, the graph is below the t-axis but slopes upward, so v<0 and acceleration is positive; speed is decreasing. Therefore the speed is increasing only for 3<t<5.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是速度 v 关于时间 t 的图像，横轴为 t（sec），纵轴为 v。图像由三段组成：从 t=0 到 t=3 是一条向下倾斜的直线，位于 t 轴上方并在 t=3 处到达 v=0；从 t=3 到 t=5 是一段向下弯的四分之一圆弧，位于 t 轴下方，从 v=0 降到约 v=-2；从 t=5 到 t=6 是一条向上倾斜的直线，仍位于 t 轴下方并在 t=6 处回到 v=0。
推理：速度增大指的是速率 |v| 增大。当速度 v 和加速度 a（即速度图像的斜率）同号时，速率增加。0<t<3 时，v>0，但图像斜率为负，所以速率减小。3<t<5 时，v<0，图像斜率也为负，所以速度和加速度同号，速率增加。5<t<6 时，v<0，但图像斜率为正，所以速率减小。因此速率增加的时间区间是 3<t<5。
